source: Django DEBUG=False browser settings with isolated synthetic identity/data fixtures

source_reference.note: No archived React runtime or source page was used as an acceptance target.

interactions.state: four accessible sections, every preview control, unsaved/discard/reset, versioned save/reload, both legacy import formats, identity-free draft export, atomic invalid/future/oversized rejection, empty workweek, invalid field focus, corrupt/denied/quota storage recovery, and zero service requests pass
four responsive settings sections are visible, selectable by horizontal arrow keys, and fit the viewport
visible JavaScript explanation and Back, Privacy, Security, and Documentation links remain usable
